description: An English email whose blocks are all within the limits of D-071 (subject 80, preheader 100, headline 80, 1 to 4 paragraphs of 600, label 30). It is stored with the rendered lengths and the cost.

input.brief: Son 30 günde sepetine ürün ekleyip alışveriş yapmayan İstanbul'daki kullanıcılara %30 indirim hatırlatması gönder. Samimi ama kısa olsun.

email.subject: {{first_name}}, your basket is waiting: 30% off
email.preheader: The items you added this month are still here, and this week they cost less.
email.headline: Still thinking it over, {{first_name}}?
paragraphs: You added a few things to your basket in the last 30 days and did not check out. No pressure, but they are still there.
This week you get 30% off everything in it. Finish your order whenever suits you.

json.summary: Warm, short reminder; the offer stays at the brief's 30%.
